content: <thought>To design a three‑step retrosynthesis we will disconnect the target molecule in the reverse order of the suggested forward reactions: (3) sulfonamide formation, (2) Doebner modification (formation of the α,β‑unsaturated acid), and (1) amide coupling. I will first locate a retrosynthetic template that breaks an amide into a carboxylic acid and an aniline, then a template for the Doebner modification (aryl aldehyde + malonic acid → α,β‑unsaturated acid), and finally a template for sulfonamide formation (aryl amine + aryl sulfonyl chloride → sulfonamide). I will retrieve suitable template IDs using the catalog search tool.
